messages:
Maya R: Uploaded a GPTQ snap-bake covering Llama2-7b, Mistral-7b, and Qwen-7b. Opening thread for quick callouts + deploy recs.

Sam B: TL;DR: Llama GPTQ-4 looks fine (-1.5% MATH), Qwen AWQ-int4 is very solid (-0.5%), Mistral GPTQ-4 has a significant hit (~-5.2% on MATH). Throughput/mem gains consistent with expectations.

Sam B: Full quick table (FP16 baseline vs our quant runs):
```
Model                 | MATH acc | Delta vs FP16 | AvgPPL | Tokens/sec | Mem (GB)
Llama2-7b FP16        | 78.4     | +0.0         | 12.1   | 480        | 13.6
Llama2-7b GPTQ-4     | 76.9     | -1.5         | 12.8   | 900        | 5.2
Mistral-7b FP16      | 80.2     | +0.0         | 11.6   | 520        | 14.0
Mistral-7b GPTQ-4    | 75.0     | -5.2         | 14.3   | 950        | 5.6
Qwen-7b FP16         | 77.0     | +0.0         | 12.4   | 460        | 13.8
Qwen-7b AWQ-int4     | 76.5     | -0.5         | 12.6   | 1200       | 4.8
```

Zara N: Spotchecks -> Mistral regressions concentrate in MATH and long code generation (Humaneval). Behavior looks like KV-cache/position alignment drift after converter optimizations. Not a pure quant noise floor.

Liam K: Repro command I ran for the failing Mistral case:
```
./run_eval --model=artifacts/mistral_gptq4 --evalsets=math,humaneval --batch=8 --seq=1024 --seed=42 --log-level=info
```
Addendum: when I enabled per-channel scale correction (pcscale) the MATH delta shrank to ~-2.1%.

Sam B: Additional notes:
- GPTQ exporter we used skips a residual-scaling pass for certain Mistral blocks -> hypothesis.
- AWQ/int4 path for Qwen looks production-friendly: best perf/cost tradeoff and tiny quality delta.
- Llama2 GPTQ-4 usable for dev tier and can be default for cheap routing.

ci-bot: Artifacts uploaded: s3://redwood-bake/artifacts/2087654321/ (models.tar.gz, eval/*.json, logs/*.log) :package:

Toni S: Deploy recs based on this snap-bake:
- Mistral: hold on promoting GPTQ-4 to prod. Use AWQ-int4 if available, else keep FP16 on Dedicated until exporter fix. Add a canary gate in routing.
- Llama2: GPTQ-4 ok for low-cost pool with monitoring on MATH and HF tests.
- Qwen: prefer AWQ-int4 for cost-sensitive tiers.

Maya R: Action items:
- Sam B: re-run Mistral with pcscale=true and with a ``rescale_residuals`` patch; include per-layer diffs and kv-consistency checks. (ETA: EOD tomorrow)
- Liam K: add targeted regression tests for long-code and math with seeds from the failing subset.
- Toni S: add routing fallback rule: if model.family==mistral and model.variant==gptq-4 then route->awq-int4 or fp16 (depending on capacity).

Zara N: Also recommend a quick numeric sanity check: run 100 deterministic traces comparing kv-cache keys before/after quant conversion (diff threshold 1e-6).

Maya R: Thanks all — let's sync tomorrow if Sam's re-run changes the delta. :thumbsup:
